samples.FormExamplesSample9:
EFormItem {
    id: standaloneItem

    error: ""
    form: null
    prop: "email"
    rowSpacing: 8
    labelWidth: 90
    required: true
    labelSuffix: "："
    resettable: true
    showMessage: true
    size: EStyle.Large
    formDisabled: false
    validateEvent: true
    inlineMessage: false
    label: qsTr("Email")
    labelPosition: "left"
    propagateToField: true
    showSuccessState: true
    validateOnChange: true
    inheritFormConfig: false
    hideRequiredAsterisk: false
    objectName: "galleryFormItem"
    requiredAsteriskPosition: "left"
    width: Math.min(parent.width, 560)
    validationMessage: qsTr("Valid format")
    requiredMessage: qsTr("Enter your email")
    validationState: EValidationState.Success
    helpText: qsTr("Used for account notifications")
    rules: [{ required: true, message: qsTr("Email is required") }]
    validator: function(value) {
        return String(value).indexOf("@") > 0 || qsTr("Enter a valid email address")
    }

    EInput {
        clearable: true
        width: parent.width
        text: "demo@example.com"
    }
}
EFormItem {
    rowSpacing: 8
    labelWidth: 90
    labelSuffix: "："
    size: EStyle.Large
    labelPosition: "left"
    label: qsTr("External error")
    width: Math.min(parent.width, 560)
    error: qsTr("Error returned by the server")

    EInput {
        width: parent.width
        text: qsTr("Reset value")
    }
}
EDescriptions {
    columns: 1
    objectName: "galleryFormFeedback"
    width: Math.min(parent.width, 560)
    model: [{
        "label": qsTr("Email"),
        "value": standaloneItem.fieldValue
    }, {
        "label": qsTr("Messages"),
        "value": standaloneItem.effectiveMessage
    }]
}
Flow {
    spacing: 10
    width: parent.width

    EButton {
        text: qsTr("Validate")
        styleType: EStyle.Primary
        objectName: "galleryFormValidate"

        onClicked: standaloneItem.validate()
    }
    EButton {
        text: qsTr("Start over")
        objectName: "galleryFormReset"

        onClicked: standaloneItem.resetField()
    }
    ETag {
        size: EStyle.Large
        styleType: standaloneItem.hasValidationError ? EStyle.Danger
            : standaloneItem.validationState === EValidationState.Success ? EStyle.Success : EStyle.Info
        text: standaloneItem.validating ? qsTr("Loading")
            : standaloneItem.hasValidationError ? qsTr("Validation failed")
            : standaloneItem.validationState === EValidationState.Success ? qsTr("Valid format") : qsTr("Input")
    }
    ETag {
        size: EStyle.Large
        text: qsTr("Edit")
        visible: standaloneItem.fieldFocused
    }
}

ui.AcrylicIntroduction: Blur background content, then add a tint and subtle noise. Adjust the controls or refresh the cached backdrop.
ui.AppBarIntroduction: Try language and theme actions, title-bar dragging, double-click maximize, window buttons and edge resizing in a separate frameless preview.
ui.AppBarPreview: Drag the title bar, double-click to maximize, or resize from the window edges.
ui.CaptchaIntroduction: Enter the displayed code and verify it. Click the image to generate another code.
ui.CatalogIntroduction: Choose a component to try its behavior and view the QML source. Use the search on the left to find a control.
ui.ChartIntroduction: View the same values as a line, bar or area chart.
ui.ClipIntroduction: Clip child content to rounded corners while keeping controls interactive. Adjust the radius or click the button.
ui.EChartsDescription: Offline Apache ECharts with legends, tooltips, zoom and live data.
ui.EChartsIntroduction: Explore 36 chart examples and copy complete options. Enable live data for supported charts, toggle legends, or use zoom controls.
ui.MediaIntroduction: Enter a local file URL or media URL to play audio or video. Use the controls to pause, seek and mute.
ui.MenuBarIntroduction: Open a menu with the mouse or arrow keys. Select an action to update the result.
ui.ParallaxIntroduction: The background moves at a different speed from the content while you scroll.
ui.QrIntroduction: Enter text or a URL to generate a QR code.
ui.RangeIntroduction: Drag either handle to select a range. Arrow keys adjust the focused handle.
ui.ShadowIntroduction: Use shadows to show elevation. Adjust the elevation to change the shadow spread and offset.
ui.ShortcutIntroduction: Click the field to record a shortcut. Press Escape to cancel, or clear the current shortcut.
ui.StaggeredIntroduction: Items with different heights are placed in the next available column.
ui.StatusError: The request could not be completed. Try loading the content again.
ui.StatusIntroduction: Switch between content, loading, empty and error states. Retry simulates a successful reload.
